# calendar attachment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:calendarAttachment`](gmeow-calendarAttachment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/calendarAttachment>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Links a message to the specific attachment that carries iCalendar data ([`mediaType`](gmeow-mediaType.md) text/calendar). A specialization of [`gmeow:hasAttachment`](gmeow-hasAttachment.md) that keeps the attachment first-class and separate from the parsed event representation.
